title: Simulation 3D Lidar
text: Lidar sensor model in 3D simulation environment, 6 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Detection range (m)} sets the maximum distance measured by lidar sensor, {Range resolution (m)} sets the resolution of lidar sensor range, {Vertical field of view (deg)}, {Vertical resolution (deg)} sets the vertical angular resolution, {Horizontal field of view (deg)}, {Horizontal resolution (deg)} sets the horizontal angular, {Distance outport} sets the output distance to measured object points, {Reflectivity outport} sets the output reflectivity of surface materials, {Output semantic segmentation} and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of sensor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Point cloud
ports.summary: Point cloud data m -by- n -by-3 array of positive real-valued [ x, y, z ] points

ports.name: Distance
ports.summary: Distance to object points m -by- n positive real-valued matrix

ports.name: Reflectivity
ports.summary: Reflectivity of surface materials m -by- n matrix of intensity values in range [0, 1]

ports.name: Labels
ports.summary: Label identifiers m -by- n array of label identifiers

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Detection range (m)
params.values: Maximum distance measured by lidar sensor 120 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Range resolution (m)
params.values: Resolution of lidar sensor range 0.002 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Vertical field of view (deg)
params.values: Vertical field of view 40 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Horizontal field of view (deg)
params.values: Horizontal field of view 360 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Distance outport
params.values: Output distance to measured object points off (default) | on

params.name: Reflectivity outport
params.values: Output reflectivity of surface materials off (default) | on

params.name: Output semantic segmentation
params.values: Output semantic segmentation map of label IDs off (default) | on

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of sensor off (default) | on
